meta.name: Repair Drone
meta.description: Pops open where it lands and lets loose a little repair drone that flies to the nearest friendly tank (yours, or a teammate's) and hovers over it, patching its armour: 15 HP when it arrives, then 10 more at the start of every turn for two rounds, never above round-start health. Land it near the tank you want mended. Enemies can shoot it down: any shell passing close by, or going off near it, knocks it out of the sky. Does no damage.
